_comment: Optional: copy to <project>/.claude/crypto-band.json. Every key has a default, so a partial file is fine.
_coins_comment: CoinGecko coin ids (never a ticker like BTC - see https://api.coingecko.com/api/v3/coins/list for the full id list). `symbol` is optional and overrides what the table shows in the 幣種 column; left out, it uses CoinGecko's own symbol for that id (already BTC/ETH/SOL/HYPE for the four below).
_sort_comment: "change24h" (default) ranks by 24h%, "change1h" by 1h%, "volume" by 24h成交量, "list" leaves the coins list's own order alone. The 排序 button cycles through all four at runtime; this just picks the starting one.
_columns_comment: "auto" (default) draws one coin a row for 5 coins or fewer, two coins a row for 6+; an explicit 1 or 2 always wins.
_feedMs_comment: Milliseconds between CoinGecko requests. Clamped to 30000 minimum no matter what this says - crypto-band-mod never polls a public API faster than once every 30s.
_pageMs_comment: How long one page holds before 翻頁 auto-advances, in ms. 0 turns auto-paging off (the 翻頁 button still works by hand).
_refreshMs_comment: How often this module re-reads this file and re-renders. Has nothing to do with how often CoinGecko is polled - see feedMs.
_animation_comment: "full" (default) flaps rows on a value change and steps the live dot; "off" leaves the board still and only repaints once a second for the countdown.
